newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher with ACCESS, OTC.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher with ACCESS, OTC.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open slightly higher Wednesday, in line with firmer after-hours ACCESS trade and stronger over-the-counter (OTC) quotes, market sources said.
In over-the-counter trade, September was quoted between $2.11 and $2.145 per million British thermal units after settling Tuesday 3.8 cents lower at $2.113.
On ACCESS, September last traded at $2.139, up 2.6 cents.
In the early cash, July Hub gas was quoted at $2.21-24, little changed from Tuesday, while August swaps were pegged at $2.175-2.20, up a couple of cents on the day.
While below-normal temperatures are blanketing the East and Midwest this week, normal to above-normal weather was forecast for the weekend though little extreme heat was expected.

With August now off the board, chart traders turned their attention to September, where support was seen at $2.08 and then at last week's low of $2.045. Resistance was pegged first at the double top at $2.16 and then at recent $2.20 high.

In the cash Tuesday, July Gulf Coast prices firmed a few cents to near the $2.20 level. July Midcon gas was up slightly to the $2.10-11 area. New York city gate gas for July was little changed in the low-$2.40s.
Injection estimates for Wednesday's weekly AGA storage report range from 55 bcf to 90 bcf. For the same week last year, stocks rose 81 bcf.
